why_trail.why: Both issues are doctrine-wording judgement in this lane's files. #596's crux is measurable: the feedback gate's ONLY postcondition is verify_episode_captured, so the delegated clause asserting a gate failure is false. Blast radius found early: three of the four #596 sites are keyed line-for-line in tests/data/store_mentions.approved.txt, so any edit there must move the census in lockstep or test_retirement_guard.py goes red — the handoff named only the CLI guard.

Issue confirmed in a sharper form: CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md was never retired (RETIRED_NAMES holds only LESSONS.md/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md), so the defect is three live sites mandating collection of an export that ZERO gates write — feedback's single postcondition is verify_episode_captured.py and archive c4 deny-globs the file. The delegated 'still fails the gate' clause is false as written and is repaired; the fourth site the issue names (the feedback imperative's crew Workflow Feedback sentence) is refuted, not a mandate. Rescoped rather than deleted because collect_feedback.py serves a live cross-project channel the per-repo episode store cannot replace.

Split verdicts, both evidenced. Defect 1 does not reproduce and never did in the corpus: zero 'code_map' hits under skills/ and git log -S over all history shows the phrasing only ever lived in issue #456's own .agent-work run records, so the 'stock close criteria' attribution is wrong. Widening it by SHAPE rather than by script name found the real instance: 16 of 17 shipped command checks use a resolver token and REVIEW_SURVEY r6-fowler.c1 was the one bare path — fixed in all three copies and proven to resolve in both layouts. Defect 2 reproduces; the convention is written from this lane's own two-round g1b review, and the evidence argues against the issue's own guessed remedy (re-consolidate with --override-reason), so that half is written down as what NOT to do.

Gate closing check passes in the anchored form the Commander re-runs; the only CLI-guard violations left are lane D2's two fenced skills/workbench/ files. test_mcp_adoption 172 passed, test_retirement_guard 16 passed, and the five suites reading the edited template 313 passed. All three REVIEW_SURVEY copies parse and share one md5. Result written with Return status complete, the census scope call flagged for the Commander to overturn, and two triage candidates staged rather than filed.
